raw_word_error.tokenization: Latin words, one character per CJK symbol, LaTeX-aware math atoms, and no whitespace tokens; interpret as a mixed-content word/token error rate.

normalized_word_error.tokenization: Latin words, one character per CJK symbol, LaTeX-aware math atoms, and no whitespace tokens; interpret as a mixed-content word/token error rate.

equation_similarity_after_normalization.method: mean normalized token edit similarity; this is an equation-similarity proxy, not Formula-CDM

table_structure_after_normalization.comparison: row count and number of cells in each row; cell text is scored separately

reading_order_after_normalization.method: share of reference block types retained in the same order within matched questions

manual_review.guidance: If both unit IDs are present, choose correct_match or incorrect_match. If only one side exists, choose missed_match when its counterpart exists elsewhere, otherwise no_counterpart. Leave unreviewed rows blank.

normalization_correct_character_harm.definition: A raw OCR/gold character match is counted as damaged if normalization does not preserve a matching normalized OCR/gold character.

confidence.reason: OCR confidence is absent from the structured output or is not attached to text spans.

notes.cer_classes: CJK text, Latin text, math, figures, tables, and other visible characters are reported separately.
notes.raw_baseline: OCR input is measured before shared style normalization; gold TeX has only been structurally converted to Markdown.
notes.unit_outcomes: better/worse/same compare character edit distance before and after normalization; perfect means zero normalized edit distance.
